summary: Wendigo Lake fire tower in Bayly Township near Englehart: a 1949 temporary lookout is recorded, and an Ontario still-standing list counted it standing around 2013.

facts.status_note: Listed as still standing in Ontario's still-standing list, which refers to MNR removal decisions as of 2013. No source read confirms its condition today.

access.note: The still-standing list says the MNR no longer maintains these towers and asks visitors not to climb them. No source read describes an official access arrangement for this tower.

facts.agency: Ontario Department of Lands and Forests

events.note: The 1949 Report of the Department of Lands and Forests, as quoted by Canada Lookouts, records a 25-foot temporary wooden lookout erected in Bayle Township (source spelling). The record does not say this structure is the tower listed later.
Ontario's still-standing list says the MNR decided, as of 2013, to remove many still-standing towers. The list marks removed towers, and Bayly is not marked removed.

notes_for_editor: Only one dated record of the tower itself exists: the 1949 report quoted by Canada Lookouts, which describes a temporary structure, so it may not be the tower listed later. The still-standing list is dated around 2013 and is the only status source; the brief's standing status is not confirmed for today. No date for the Facebook group post could be read, and it was readable only as its title, so treat its abandoned description as unverified. Brief coordinates (47.862553, -79.699692) are consistent with the Wendigo Lake and Englehart description. firelookout.ca and the LIO geohub dataset gave no readable record (JavaScript pages). No build year, height or design is supported by a source read.
